parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—sorry about the typo. Saved-view renaming can vary a bit depending on where the view was created.

Could you confirm which part of the product you’re using (e.g., Reports/Dashboards, a Table/Grid view, etc.) and whether you’re in the web app? If you can, please also share the exact screen name where you see the saved view list (or paste the name of the menu you’re using).

In the meantime, a common pattern is:
1) Open the saved view
2) Look for an options menu (often “•••” or a dropdown next to the view name)
3) Select “Rename” (if available)

Once you tell us which feature you’re in, we can point you to the exact menu path or the right docs section for renaming saved views.
